definition.calendar: NYSE US equity trading calendar; exchange holidays skipped; DST by America/New_York; early close uses official last regular-session bar.
definition.multiple_signal_policy: CO_EMIT_ALL_MATCHES_IN_PRECEDENCE_ORDER; precedence is ordering, not suppression.
definition.purpose: Classify VST directional setups from prior-session option GEX capital-type structure and issue notification-only paper plans.
definition.rationale: Ticker-specific GEX rules selected from full-period research; see strategy.md for rule-level rationale.
definition.source_refresh_gate: At/after 07:30 America/New_York on current US trading session D1: latest complete GEX ObservationDate must equal previous US trading session D0; exactly one BC/BP/SC/SP row; non-null GEXDelta/Close/VWAP; 60 prior complete observations; canonical source revision stable for this heartbeat. Otherwise NOT_READY and create nothing.

out_of_sample_window.reason: Full available period was inspected during rule discovery/selection.

signal_definitions.confidence_method: Fixed research confidence label based on historical sample size, directional consistency and rule stability; not recalculated live.
signal_definitions.definition: VST price and PCR both decline; historically downside tends to continue for one additional session.
signal_definitions.entry_policy: Open of D1 07:30 America/New_York 30-minute bar; D1 is first US trading session after ObservationDate.
exit_conditions: Scheduled exit at D1 final regular-session 30-minute bar Close
Opposing signal: does not alter this signal outcome
Missing required entry/exit bar: PENDING/cancel pre-entry as defined in strategy.md
